#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <sstream>
#include <vector>

int main() {
    int n;
    std::string s;
    
    std::cin >> n;
    std::cin >> s;
    
    int maxWord = 0;
    int outsideWords = 0;
    int current = 0;
    bool inside = false;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
        char ch = s[i];
        if (ch == '(') {
            maxWord = std::max(maxWord, current);
            current = 0;
            inside = true;
        } else if (ch == ')') {
            if (current > 0) outsideWords++;
            current = 0;
            inside = false;
        } else if (ch == '_') {
            if (inside && current > 0) outsideWords++;
            else if (!inside) maxWord = std::max(maxWord, current);
            current = 0;
        } else {
            current++;
        }
    }
    maxWord = std::max(maxWord, current);
    std::cout << maxWord << " " << outsideWords << std::endl;
    
    return 0;
}
